question: Does porting Frontier's SURVIVES critique-reconstruct adapter (non-oracle structural analysis of intent + observation-derived AX state/retrieved_template without alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/header_key/body_field/auth_scope, model-derived calibrated confidence) into src/spider/kernel.py resolve() preserve alias-OOD correct>=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact matcher), false_accept<=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim replay p<0.05), exact-match>=0.90, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15 on synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth alias-OOD and live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees including mixed multi-channel (header+body+query) and production-SPA heterogeneity, while reporting end-to-end economics (tokens/browser/latency/retrieval+reconstruction+verification amortized) vs verbatim replay vs RAG vs rule-based proxy and vs instruction baselines with training cost/stability?
hypothesis: A product-kernel port of Frontier's genuine rule-based critique-reconstruct adapter into src/spider/kernel.py — conditioned only on (intent, observation-derived state from real DOM/AX tree at 1280x720 or synthetic URL/header/body dict, retrieved_template/candidates) with structural scoring (slot count, path segments, query/header/body key presence, prefix structure) and deterministic rewrite handling header+body+query including mixed multi-channel composition (header+body+query within one request) via alphabetically-sorted adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry logic before _bind, confidence = softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN when max_score<0.80 (not hardcoded constant, std>0.05) — will (H1) preserve synthetic alias-OOD performance within 0.05 of Frontier rule proxy (40/40 1.0) and (H2) generalize to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees on header/body/auth aliasing including mixed multi-channel stratum, achieving alias-OOD pooled correct>=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 null, McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH expected 0/N), false_accept<=0.15 at least 0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY with McNemar p<0.05, exact-match>=0.90, no-applicable UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence), while matching Frontier audit constraints (no forbidden keys, 0/40 registry leak) and reporting training cost/stability (wall-clock, tokens/calls, CV across 3 seeds) and retrieval+reconstruction+verification economics vs B-RAG-TFIDF/B-RAG-EMBED vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY vs B-INSTRUCTION vs frontier RECONSTRUCTION-RULE proxy.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but any primary gate fails: (F1) alias-OOD synthetic pooled (N>=40: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) correct<0.50 or binomial vs 0.10 p>=0.05 or McNemar vs B-EXACT-MATCH p>=0.05 or absolute <0.40; (F2) mixed multi-channel stratum (N=10) correct<0.40 (diagnostic for composition failure); (F3) false_accept on alias-OOD >0.25 or not >=0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (paired McNemar p>=0.05); (F4) exact-match stratum (N>=12) correct<0.85 (requires >=0.90 for product port; <0.85 is definite regression); (F5) no-applicable UNKNOWN precision<0.70 or ECE>0.25; (F6) product port significantly degrades vs Frontier rule proxy (>0.10 absolute correct drop on synthetic pooled or ECE exceeds by >0.10) indicating integration regression. Learned non-inferiority not required to falsify product port (rule parity is the port test), but if port introduces instability CV>0.5 across 3 seeds (42,43,44) on synthetic it is flagged. Live stratum falsified if N_live>=20 and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH passes but live alias-OOD correct<0.40 or false_accept>0.25. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires S1-S7 plus controls PASS (see decision_rule). Live exploratory if N_live<20 or PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH fails — then SURVIVES bounded to synthetic orthogonal+mixed with disclosure, not MEASUREMENT_INVALID. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC/NC fail, oracle leak detected (reads of alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template in derived_context or hardcoded constant confidence), alias-OOD N<32, >20% harness errors, BrowserGym/Playwright integration broken for product kernel, or product kernel hash unchanged (port not applied).

baselines.description: Current SPIDER kernel baseline: SpiderKernel.resolve with exact intent equality (L97 m.intent != intent), min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. Prior Frontier 0/40 alias-OOD expected 0/30-0/40. Tests whether any aliasing resolved without reconstruction.
baselines.expected: 0/40 correct on alias-OOD (header/body/auth orthogonal + mixed), McNemar reference for product port.

baselines.description: Retrieve top-1 mechanism by exact intent equality scan in registry order; replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind without critique/rewriting, abort only if required_slots missing. Measures negative-transfer harm of naive reuse.
baselines.expected: 1.0 false_accept on alias-OOD (replays wrong channel), gap >=0.15 vs product port with McNemar p<0.05.

baselines.description: TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; retrieve top-1 then verbatim bind (no reconstruction). Fit only on train registry. Tests retrieval alone without adaptation.
baselines.expected: 0/40 on alias-OOD (retrieval cannot solve orthogonal aliasing), best RAG gap proves reconstruction not dominated by retrieval.

baselines.description: Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline deterministic) retriever over intent+template; top-1 then verbatim bind. If unavailable offline deterministically, mark unavailable and use TFIDF with disclosure. Never uses ground-truth context signals.
baselines.expected: 0/40 on alias-OOD; if both RAGs 0/40, product port must not be >0.10 below best RAG (otherwise retrieval failure not port failure).

baselines.description: Uniform random among registry mechanisms whose intent matches and required_slots satisfied; else UNKNOWN. Chance-level baseline.
baselines.expected: ~3-10% correct chance; confirms alias-OOD not solvable by guessing.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline: same product kernel but prompt injected with natural-language site procedure (e.g., shopping flow, ALFWorld planning) but no parameterized mechanism retrieval/reconstruction. Agent must discover alias manifestation via instruction following. Same budget/model/tools. Tests whether instructions alone achieve transfer without semantic resolve. Instruction tokens amortized honestly.
baselines.expected: Below product port on alias-OOD; product expected >=0.15 above instruction correct and cheaper amortized per success.

baselines.description: PRODUCT SYSTEM UNDER TEST: Ported kernel src/spider/kernel.py with critique-reconstruct adapter integrated into SpiderKernel.resolve() after retrieval: structural scorer+rewriter conditioned only on (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template/candidates) scoring slot count, path segments, query/header/body key presence, prefix structure, rewriting path<->query/header/body/auth including mixed multi-channel composition before _bind; confidence softmax temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80. No hidden_expected access. Exported as SpiderKernel.resolve with reconstruct flag.
baselines.expected: Pooled alias-OOD 40/40 1.0 on synthetic (parity with Frontier 1.0 within 0.05), live alias-OOD >=0.50 if N_live>=20, false_accept 0.0, exact-match 12/12 1.0, UNKNOWN precision 1.0, ECE<=0.15.

baselines.description: REFERENCE frontier RECONSTRUCTION-RULE from EXP-FRONTIER-35766532429 (choose_adoptions + rewrite_template_multi, same softmax/jitter, same derived_context). Run head-to-head on identical registry/task splits to quantify port fidelity. Not a baseline to beat but a parity comparator: product port must be within 0.10 correct and 0.05 ECE of this proxy on synthetic pooled.
baselines.expected: 40/40 1.0 pooled, 30/30 orthogonal, 10/10 mixed, ECE ~0.08; product port within delta thresholds.

positive_control.description: On exact-match stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions match, no aliasing), all methods P-SPIDER-RECONSTRUCT, B-EXACT-MATCH, and R-FRONTIER-RULE-PROXY must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies product kernel resolves when no adaptation required; failure indicates harness/registry bug or integration regression, not hypothesis failure. Control IDs: PC-EXACT-MATCH and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC-EXACT-MATCH: 12/12 1.0 correct for product port and frontier proxy, 12/12 for B-EXACT-MATCH. PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH: >=80% of attempted live BrowserGym tasks must load DOM/AX tree at 1280x720 without truncation/timeout (CDP AX nodes>10, url and method observed). If <80% healthy, live stratum is exploratory and claim bounds to synthetic orthogonal+mixed only (not MEASUREMENT_INVALID).

null_control.description: On no-applicable stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism) every method must return UNKNOWN (or gated confidence<0.80) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: Empty registry (N>=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% (validates kernel does not hallucinate). Failure indicates hallucination/miscalibration or confidence mis-wiring in product port, triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Control IDs: NC-NO-APPLICABLE, NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY.
null_control.expected_behavior: NC-NO-APPLICABLE: product port UNKNOWN precision 1.0 (12/12), false 0. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: 6/6 100% UNKNOWN. Audit checks no forbidden key reads.

measurement_validity: 1. Registry construction: For each synthetic task, registry contains exactly one training mechanism (from alias train template: header ApiKey/X-Reset-Token/Authorization variants, body apiKey/key/token variants, auth scope/admin_scope/permission variants) + one distractor alias template with equal confidence 0.9 + one exact-match distractor at 0.8, all preconditions={} guards={} to isolate aliasing. Test query uses held-out alias form (e.g., train ApiKey, test X-Api-Key) with same semantic intent string as training (so exact matcher failure due to template aliasing requiring reconstruction, not intent mismatch). No test template appears verbatim in registry (0/40 leak check: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed). Mixed multi-channel tasks: registry training mechanism uses single-channel form, test requires simultaneous header+body+query rewriting within one bound_action. Live BrowserGym tasks: sampled via BrowserGym 0.14.3 WebShop/ALFWorld at 1280x720; registry built from training trajectories, test tasks are held-out goal variations with aliased endpoint/field manifested in observed AX/DOM; no test live template verbatim in registry. Preprocessing fit on TRAIN only.

2. State representation — genuine non-oracle with BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720: context dict provided to resolve/reconstruction contains ONLY observation-derived fields from real browser state: url, method, url_path, url_query dict, url_segments, headers_observed dict, body_observed (JSON/string if available), ax_tree_snapshot (CDP AX tree text snapshot hash + truncated 2k tokens for parsing, viewport 1280x720), and intent string. MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, header_key, body_field, auth_scope, expected_template or any field encoding alias answer (stored separately as hidden_expected metadata not passed to any method). Synthetic tasks use minimal derived dict without AX tree to isolate mechanism; live tasks use full AX-derived dict. Product kernel src/spider/kernel.py reconstruct code must read only derived_context keys (url/header/body/AX), not forbidden keys. Audit inspects code for reads of forbidden keys and hardcoded confidence constants.

3. Action representation: Mechanism action_template is string template containing ${slot} parameters in URL path, query param, header value, body JSON field, or auth scope, and for mixed tasks simultaneously header+body+query slots. Binding via deterministic kernel _bind plus header/body field substitution. Product reconstruction may score each candidate template's structural match to observation-derived state and/or rewrite template structure before _bind conditioned ONLY on (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template/candidates). Rewriter deterministic for product port (must handle mixed composition generically via adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry + multi-field rewrite). Learned variant not required for product port (training cost reported as 0 for rule port, with disclosure if GRPO unavailable). Confidence must be derived from normalized structural score (softmax over candidates temp 0.15) and gated UNKNOWN at <0.80 for ECE; constant 0.95/0.05 hardcoding prohibited and triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

4. Orthogonal alias families, mixed multi-channel, and held-out: Synthetic orthogonal 30 tasks = 3 families x10 intents: (a) header-based (ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token vs Authorization Bearer aliasing), (b) body JSON field (apiKey vs key vs api_key vs token), (c) auth permission (scope read vs admin_scope vs permission header). Each family 7 standard +3 held-out variations (novel header X-Api-Key, body field api_token, permission X-Scope) not in rewrite table requiring key/segment analysis. Report overall 10/family and held-out-9 subset. Mixed stratum: 10 tasks where aliasing spans header+body+query within one request (e.g., header ApiKey + body apiKey + query permission simultaneously aliased), requiring joint multi-field rewriting; training registry uses single-channel forms only, tests compositional generalization. Live BrowserGym WebShop/ALFWorld: attempt 20+20 tasks with analogous header/body/query aliasing manifested in real request headers/body or URL aliasing observed in AX/DOM; add 10 live mixed if feasible; exploratory if fewer. Production-SPA heterogeneity disclosed via BrowserGym viewport 1280x720 and AX diversity metrics.

5. Product kernel integration and determinism: Product port must be committed to src/spider/kernel.py (verified by audit import+hash and git diff), exposing SpiderKernel.resolve that internally calls reconstruct path when aliasing detected, with MechanismRegistry write/read, _bind, and confidence derivation inspectable. No monkey-patching in run_experiment.py. All RNG via numpy RandomState(42) and random.seed(42); BrowserGym Playwright viewport fixed 1280x720, CDP AX tree collection deterministic; embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Each task evaluated once per method (paired design); bootstrap resampling for CIs uses block-permutation over tasks (2000 resamples) respecting trajectory grouping if live tasks grouped by site/session. Seeds 42,43,44 for stability reporting across 3 independent registry splits.

6. Holdout and leakage controls: All alias families and mixed stratum stratified; train never sees test alias form nor mixed composition (verify 0/40 synthetic templates appear verbatim in registry; same for live if available). TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry only. Reconstruction rule derived from training alias documentation only; held-out forms and mixed compositions require structural generalization. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected or test-template verbatim except via observation parsing. Registry intent-equality leak verified 0/40. Live tasks split by website (WebShop vs ALFWorld) with no site identity leakage into retriever. Product port training (if any) uses only synthetic train split (not held-out, not mixed, not live).

7. Sample counts and BrowserGym feasibility: Synthetic alias-OOD 30 orthogonal (10 per family inc 3 held-out) +10 mixed =40, exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 =70 synthetic tasks per method x8 methods (~560 calls). Live BrowserGym: attempt 20 WebShop +20 ALFWorld =40 tasks +10 live mixed if feasible per method if accessible; exploratory only — if unavailable or >50% truncation/failed loads, mark exploratory and bound confirmatory claim to synthetic orthogonal+mixed with disclosure per frozen spec. Overall alias-OOD N>=40 required for confirmatory binomial/McNemar power (minimum 32 if live partially unavailable with disclosure); live stratum reported separately with Wilson CIs. BrowserGym 0.14.3 installed via pip, Playwright chromium installed, AX tree collected via CDP at 1280x720.

8. Blinding, oracle prohibition, and auditability: Product adapter not tuned on test alias forms nor on mixed compositions; held-out variations excluded from mapping table. Context forbidden keys filtered at harness level before resolve call (derive_state from observed URL/headers/body/AX, not from fixture). Harness exposes reconstruct_resolve(intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) with signature inspectable; product kernel must expose same. Mixed tasks audit that rewriter composes single-channel rewrites, not memorizes mixed fixture. Reading alias_family etc. or constant confidence triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per Frontier parent audit fixes.

9. Verification, metrics, and economics: correct_resolution = resolved template binds to URL/header/body that verifies against expected postcondition (hidden_expected_template bound equality inc header/body field equality and for mixed all channels jointly); false_accept = wrong template/bound incorrectly/should have abstained; UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable or gated confidence<0.80. All three sum to 1.0 per stratum. Calibration via ECE over 5 confidence bins (confidence derived from structural score) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired vs exact and vs verbatim; bootstrap ECE CI (2000). Economics: per-task tokens (retrieval+reconstruction+verification), browser calls, wall latency ms; amortized cost per success = (retrieval+reconstruction+verification tokens)/success rate; report vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (0.15 gap), vs B-RAG-TFIDF/EMBED (retrieval efficiency), vs B-INSTRUCTION (200 tokens instruction amortized f=10), vs R-FRONTIER-RULE-PROXY parity (delta economics within 10%). Training cost/stability: for rule port wall-clock near 0, retrieval+reconstruction steps; if GRPO/System-One trained report 3-seed variance/CV, LLM calls/tokens, wall-clock — but not gating SURVIVES.

10. Prereg freeze and provenance: Prereg frozen before any outcome-bearing measurement; code (src/spider/kernel.py hash, registry.py, models.py), fixtures (synthetic alias families hash, BrowserGym version 0.14.3 pin, WebShop/ALFWorld task hashes), decision thresholds, and BrowserGym CDP AX collection config hashed in freeze.json. Deterministic seeds logged. Raw evidence preserved: per-task CSV with correct/false_accept/UNKNOWN/confidence, registry JSONL per family, cost_economics.json (tokens/browser/latency per method), BrowserGym traces (AX snapshot hashes, viewport), provenance with run id, commits, hashes, BrowserGym health metrics.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on synthetic alias-OOD pooled (N>=40: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) unless stated; live BrowserGym stratum reported separately with same thresholds exploratory. Compute per-method correct_resolution, false_accept, UNKNOWN rates with Wilson 95% CI; paired McNemar for P-SPIDER-RECONSTRUCT vs B-EXACT-MATCH (correct) and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (false_accept); one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null; bootstrap block-permutation ECE CI (2000, trajectory-grouped if live). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (C1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (product and frontier proxy correct>=0.90 and false_accept<=0.10 on exact-match 12/12) and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH either passes (>=80% healthy) or correctly bounds live to exploratory per spec; (C2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (product UNKNOWN precision>=0.90 false_accept<=0.10) AND NC-EMPTY 100% UNKNOWN; (C3) alias-OOD pooled S1: P-SPIDER-RECONSTRUCT correct>=0.50 AND binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 AND McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (0/40 expected) AND orthogonal subset correct>=0.50 and mixed subset correct>=0.40 and per-family each >=0.50 (10/10 ideal) with held-out subset >=0.50; (C4) S2: product false_accept<=0.15 AND strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept; (C5) S3: product exact-match stratum correct>=0.90 (no regression, within 0.05 of frontier proxy 1.0); (C6) S4: product no-applicable precision>=0.85 AND ECE<=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence, std>0.05 not constant, 3 empty bins disclosed); (C7) not dominated by retrieval: product pooled correct not >0.10 below best RAG verbatim correct on same alias-OOD; (C8) port fidelity: product pooled correct within 0.10 absolute of R-FRONTIER-RULE-PROXY and ECE within 0.05 (largest per-family gap <=0.10). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if C3-C8 fail while C1-C2 PASS (valid negative, product port does not generalize or regresses vs frontier). MIXED if C3 passes but C4 or C6 fails (correct but miscalibrated/harmful). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if C1 or C2 fails, oracle leak or hardcoded confidence detected, alias-OOD N<32, harness errors >20%, BrowserGym integration broken for product kernel synthesis, or product kernel hash unchanged (no port) — not falsification. Live confirmatory (if N_live>=20 and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH passes): report same S1-S2 on live pooled+orthogonal+mixed; synthesis SURVIVES requires synthetic C3-C8 plus live alias-OOD correct>=0.50 binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and false_accept<=0.15; if live fails but synthetic passes, overall SURVIVES bounded to synthetic orthogonal+mixed with disclosure (not FALSIFIED). Economics and training cost reported regardless but do not gate SURVIVES (exploratory unless economics degrades >2x vs frontier proxy).
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES synthetic+live (or synthetic pooled with live exploratory bound correctly disclosed): Product port preserves Frontier 40/40 1.0 parity within 0.10 and ECE within 0.05, and on live BrowserGym WebShop/ALFWorld (if N_live>=20) generalizes with correct>=0.50 false_accept<=0.15 ECE<=0.15 including mixed multi-channel. This validates genuine non-oracle reconstruction beyond URL path/query to orthogonal header/body/auth aliasing including compositional header+body+query within one request on real CDP AX trees at 1280x720 with production-SPA heterogeneity. Product should add reconstruction layer after retrieval (critique-reconstruct conditioned on intent+observation-derived AX state+retrieved_template, confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80) before _bind/execute, with verification/repair boundary and freshness guard; unblocks cross-site parameterized transfer where header/body/auth aliasing is common, addresses MemHarness negative-transfer and UNKNOWN abstention. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances from EXPERIMENTAL (narrow synthetic URL+orthogonal) to VALIDATED at product-kernel level bounded to genuine reconstruction on tested orthogonal families plus mixed composition and live BrowserGym with calibrated UNKNOWN (rule-based port validated) — PRODUCT_CORE candidate pending replicated learned GRPO/System-One stability, end-to-end economics at scale, and kernel tests pass; promote_to_product true pending audit PASS and browser integration tests. Report economics: retrieval+reconstruction+verification cost per successful task vs RAG vs verbatim vs instruction (tokens/browser/latency amortized) and training cost/stability vs frontier proxy.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED (controls PASS but synthetic pooled <0.50 or mixed <0.40 or false_accept>0.15 or not >=0.15 below verbatim or ECE>0.15 or port degrades >0.10 vs frontier proxy): Genuine state-conditioned structural reconstruction as ported does not beat exact matcher/verbatim on controlled orthogonal aliasing or mixed composition, or only by inflating false_accepts/miscalibration, or product integration regresses vs frontier proxy. Product must NOT add reconstruction layer as product feature for these header/body/auth families/compositions; keep exact-intent matching and require agents to supply exact intents or pre-normalized templates; prioritize explicit alias catalogs, server-side routing normalization, or per-site header/body mapping tables. Frontier mechanism closed for this adapter class and families incl held-out/mixed; next Frontier attack tests orthogonal basin (artifact-driven workflow compilation, hierarchical DAG synthesis, program-synthesis repair, cache invalidation) rather than tuning reconstruction thresholds. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains EXPERIMENTAL at prior 40/40 synthetic narrow ceiling (not global falsification of all semantic resolution), or if product port regression then bounded REJECTED for product-kernel instantiation. Live failure (if N_live>=20 PC passes but live correct<0.40 or false_accept>0.25) indicates synthetic-to-real gap not closed: synthetic observation tautologically encodes answer (bound then parse back) does not transfer to noisy AX/DOM; product must invest in AX denoising, header/body extraction robustness, or instruction fallback before PRODUCT_CORE. Learned GRPO failure not required for port decision but reported.
estimated_cost: Low-moderate: 70 synthetic (40 alias-OOD orthogonal+mixed +12 exact +12 no-applicable +6 empty) + up to 50 live (40 single +10 mixed) =120 tasks x8 methods =960 deterministic kernel resolve+bind calls plus TF-IDF/embedding retrieval offline (<25 min CPU, no paid LLM for rule port). Product port code change in src/spider/kernel.py (<200 lines structural scorer+rewriter, softmax temp 0.15 + jitter, adapt-any-observed-key logic ported from Frontier audit-PASS). BrowserGym 0.14.3 install + Playwright chromium at 1280x720 adds <50 browser navigations with CDP AX extraction (<45 min if fixtures local, <6 min per 20 live tasks). Total compute <5h on single runner, no large datasets committed, no giant raw data. Offline embedding local CPU. If LLM-based GRPO unavailable, product port stays rule-based and cost drops to <40 min synthetic-only.
expected_information_gain: Very high: First product-kernel validation of Frontier's 3x SURVIVES genuine reconstruction (40/40 1.0 synthetic orthogonal+mixed) by porting audit-PASS adapter into src/spider/kernel.py and testing parity within 0.10/0.05 plus first live-browser generalization at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees on header/body/auth plus novel mixed multi-channel composition and production-SPA heterogeneity — directly addresses Director PIVOT mandate and the two dominant unknowns blocking PRODUCT_CORE (synthetic-to-real gap with 0/3 live prior, and port fidelity without oracle leakage). Either outcome changes product/architecture decision: positive validates retrieval+reconstruction vs exact matcher (0/40) and vs verbatim (1.0 false_accept) for orthogonal families/mixed/live with calibrated abstention (ECE<=0.15, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85) and measured economics vs verbatim/RAG/instruction plus training cost/stability, unblocking cross-site transfer sequencing with unknown/verify boundary and justifying PRODUCT_CORE promotion path; negative cleanly falsifies alias-adaptation prior for product kernel (header/body/auth/mixed/live) and parks C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE forcing pivot to compilation/synthesis per heuristic, avoiding wasted promotion of a phantom. Strong baselines (exact 0/40, verbatim 1.0 false, TFIDF 0/40, embed, random, instruction), PC/NC with calibration gates plus header/body/auth/mixed non-vacuous channel isolation (url-only 0/40, body-only 10/40, headers-only 20/40 from Frontier audit) and trajectory-grouped permutation ensure result not explained by retrieval strength, hallucination, vacuous mechanisms, or oracle leakage (forbidden keys audit). Orthogonal to 30+ prior freshness/PMI/TV loops and to narrow URL-only POC (30/30), satisfying product charter to turn surviving research into shippable capability. Reporting end-to-end economics (tokens/browser/latency/retrieval+reconstruction+verification amortized) vs strong baselines fulfills Director's economics gate for C-PRODUCT-ECON sequencing.
